method: NumPy Moller-Trumbore ray-triangle intersections on MuJoCo-compiled head_link mesh; Trimesh topology audit with merged coincident vertices
cameraMount: Nominal torso-mounted original364M optical camera, retained 18x32 crop
interpretation: All retained rays first exit the closed head housing. The archived MuJoCo-Warp ray_mesh_with_bvh tests only the nearest hit and rejects it if back-facing; it does not query later intersections. Excluding head_link from scalar MuJoCo depth rays reproduces that per-mesh rejection for this fixed nominal camera mount. This does not justify excluding the head for another camera position or an externally located sensor.
